reading_1.theme: Aspartate-glutamate transamination linking carbon and nitrogen metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the malate-aspartate shuttle and oxaloacetate metabolism, framed as the hub that links glutamate, aspartate and alanine transamination with gluconeogenesis and mitochondrial NADH transfer.

reading_2.theme: Oxaloacetate-centred aspartate-glutamate metabolism and gluconeogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the malate-aspartate shuttle and oxaloacetate metabolism. This is a transamination hub linking NADH transfer into mitochondria to amino acid metabolism and to carbon supply for gluconeogenesis.

shared: M-decay: degradation of maternal mRNAs by maternally stored factors
epigenetic programming in the zygotic pronuclei
Z-decay: degradation of maternal mRNAs by zygotically expressed factors
Chromatin modifications during the maternal to zygotic transition (MZT)
POU5F1 (OCT4), SOX2, NANOG activate genes related to proliferation

reading_1.theme: Germline, gametogenesis, fertilization and the maternal-to-zygotic transition
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe maternal mRNA decay, zygotic genome activation, zygotic epigenetic reprogramming and early cleavage/lineage specification, framed here as the post-fertilization handover phase of a reproductive programme that spans gonadal hormones, oogenesis, spermatogenesis, piRNA silencing and fertilization.

reading_2.theme: Maternal-to-zygotic transition and early embryonic lineage specification
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe maternal mRNA clearance, zygotic genome activation and first lineage choices (trophectoderm, germ cells, pluripotency), framed as the core of pre-implantation development leading to inner cell mass formation.

reading_1.theme: Golgi-endosome membrane trafficking
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the cargo routes between plasma membrane, Golgi and endosomes (endocytosis, constitutive secretion, receptor recycling, Golgi targeting), framed as the trafficking outputs carried out by membrane budding and tubulation machinery.

reading_2.theme: Golgi-endosome membrane trafficking and secretion
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe constitutive secretion, Golgi-to-endosome and plasma-membrane-to-endosome transport and receptor recycling, framed here as the cargo routes of a Golgi-centred trafficking network governed by Rab GTPases, retrograde transport and lysosomal delivery.

shared: obsolete catecholamine uptake involved in synaptic transmission
obsolete regulation of catecholamine uptake involved in synaptic transmission

reading_1.theme: Catecholamine neurotransmitter synthesis and transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are dopamine/norepinephrine synthesis and their synaptic reuptake and transport, implemented by SLC6 transporters (whose defects cause disease) and vesicular loading.

reading_2.theme: Catecholamine synthesis, reuptake and dopaminergic synaptic transmission
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe dopamine and catecholamine synthesis and transporter-mediated reuptake, framed as regulation of monoaminergic neurotransmission at the synapse.

shared: Defective RHAG causes regulator type Rh-null hemolytic anemia (RHN)

reading_1.theme: Rhesus glycoprotein-mediated ammonium and CO2 transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover biosynthesis of Rh blood group/RHAG membrane proteins and Rh-null disease. Here they are the gas-channel machinery that moves ammonia/ammonium and carbon dioxide across epithelial and erythrocyte membranes.

reading_2.theme: Rhesus glycoproteins in erythrocyte ammonium/CO2 transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the erythrocyte Rh/RHAG membrane complex and its deficiency, framed as a gas and ammonium transmembrane channel.

shared: positive regulation of voltage-gated calcium channel activity

reading_1.theme: Cellular calcium signalling and homeostasis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are calcium entry and intracellular calcium signalling, with voltage-gated channel activation, caffeine-triggered store release and calcium sequestration, balanced by sodium/calcium exchange and cytosolic calcium clearance.

reading_2.theme: Cytosolic calcium signalling and homeostasis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover calcium entry and store release (voltage-gated channels, caffeine-sensitive ryanodine release) and sequestration, which the theme balances with Na+/Ca2+ exchange to lower cytosolic calcium.

shared: SLBP Dependent Processing of Replication-Dependent Histone Pre-mRNAs
co-transcriptional mRNA 3'-end processing, cleavage and polyadenylation pathway
positive regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome
SLBP independent Processing of Histone Pre-mRNAs
mRNA 3'-end processing by stem-loop binding and cleavage

reading_1.theme: Nuclear RNA processing: 3'-end formation, splicing, snRNA maturation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are mRNA 3'-end formation (cleavage and polyadenylation, histone stem-loop processing, Pol II termination) and its regulation, framed as the terminal maturation step of nuclear pre-mRNA processing alongside splicing, snRNP biogenesis and nuclear RNA surveillance.

reading_2.theme: Nuclear RNA processing: 3'-end formation, splicing and decay
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are pre-mRNA 3'-end cleavage and polyadenylation, histone stem-loop processing and Pol II termination, forming the 3'-end maturation step within the broader nuclear splicing, snRNA and RNA surveillance machinery.

shared: Defective HK1 causes hexokinase deficiency (HK deficiency)

reading_1.theme: Fructose, glycerol and pentose sugar metabolism and inborn errors
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover fructose and glycerol/alditol metabolism and their inherited defects, framed here as hexose and polyol entry routes into glycolysis that sit alongside galactose, pentose-phosphate and glucuronate-xylulose metabolism and their enzyme deficiencies.

reading_2.theme: Hepatic hexose-phosphate metabolism: fructose, glycolysis, gluconeogenesis, glycogen
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the fructose and glycerol entry routes (fructokinase, aldolase B, glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate) and their inborn errors. Here they act as feeders into the hexose- and triose-phosphate pools used by glycolysis, gluconeogenesis and glycogen metabolism.

shared: Vasopressin regulates renal water homeostasis via Aquaporins
Defective AVP does not bind AVPR1A,B and causes neurohypophyseal diabetes insipidus (NDI)
regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure by vasopressin
Defective AVP does not bind AVPR2 and causes neurohypophyseal diabetes insipidus (NDI)

reading_1.theme: Renal water and salt homeostasis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are vasopressin-aquaporin renal water reabsorption and antidiuresis, the water arm of body fluid osmoregulation alongside renal sodium, potassium and chloride transport.

reading_2.theme: Renal water and salt homeostasis and osmoregulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the vasopressin-aquaporin water-reabsorption arm of body fluid homeostasis, alongside renal sodium, potassium and chloride transport and cellular osmotic responses.

reading_1.theme: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate/glutamine and aspartate interconversion with alpha-ketoglutarate transport, framed here as the central nitrogen-handling and anaplerotic hub linking amino-acid transamination to oxaloacetate, alanine, gluconeogenesis and glutamine/glycine conjugation.

reading_2.theme: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the central glutamate/glutamine/aspartate interconversions and alpha-ketoglutarate transport. Here they are the nitrogen-handling hub that extends to arginine and citrulline (urea-cycle-adjacent) metabolism.

shared: mitotic intra-S DNA damage checkpoint signaling
response to cell cycle checkpoint signaling
TP53 Regulates Transcription of DNA Repair Genes

reading_1.theme: Replication stress response and genome stability
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover the intra-S checkpoint, resolution of recombination intermediates and p53-driven repair transcription, framed as checkpoint control of genome stability under replication stress such as fork reversal, R-loops and topoisomerase lesions.

reading_2.theme: Homologous recombination repair of DNA double-strand breaks
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame genome-stability control, checkpoint signalling and resolution of recombination intermediates as the regulatory and end-stage steps of homologous-recombination-based double-strand break and cross-link repair during replication and mitosis.

shared: positive regulation of mesenchymal stem cell proliferation
positive regulation of mesenchymal stem cell differentiation

reading_1.theme: Wnt/BMP-driven osteoblast differentiation and skeletal development
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe Wnt control of mesenchymal stem cell expansion and osteoblast proliferation and differentiation, framed as the progenitor-commitment step of bone formation alongside RUNX2, BMP signalling and ossification.

reading_2.theme: Osteoblast differentiation and bone formation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover Wnt-driven control of proliferation and differentiation in mesenchymal stem cells and osteoblasts. This is upstream signalling in skeletal development, acting with RUNX2 and BMP programmes towards ossification.

shared: SARS-CoV-2 targets PDZ proteins in cell-cell junction
SARS-CoV-1 targets host intracellular signalling and regulatory pathways
SARS-CoV-1 targets PDZ proteins in cell-cell junction
SARS-CoV-2 targets host intracellular signalling and regulatory pathways

reading_1.theme: Viral attachment, entry and host manipulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are coronavirus manipulation of host signalling and junctional PDZ proteins, the post-entry host-interaction phase alongside viral attachment, entry and assembly.

reading_2.theme: Viral attachment, entry and host-pathway hijacking
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are SARS coronavirus targeting of host junctional PDZ proteins and signalling, the host-manipulation side of viral infection alongside attachment, entry and fusion of diverse viruses.

reading_1.theme: Glutamate and glutamine nitrogen metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate, glutamine and aspartate interconversions and ammonium handling, framed as cellular nitrogen assimilation and disposal coupled to the malate-aspartate shuttle.

reading_2.theme: Glutamate-glutamine nitrogen metabolism and ammonia homeostasis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover glutamine/glutamate interconversion for fixing and using nitrogen and keeping ammonium in balance. The malate-aspartate shuttle links aspartate to mitochondrial redox.

shared: [untitled BTM module] These genes converge on integrin-based adhesion and the cytoskeletal signalling that lets cells grip and respond to their extracellular matrix, with a supporting cast of metabolic and gene-regulatory proteins. Talin links activated integrin tails to actin, integrin-linked kinase couples the adhesion complex to downstream survival and contractility signalling, and a Rho GDP-dissociation inhibitor restrains Rho-family GTPases so that actin remodelling is switched rather than constant; a microtubule-associated protein and the SNARE-recycling factor alpha-SNAP tie the same events to cytoskeletal turnover and membrane fusion.

reading_1.theme: Platelet activation, degranulation and cytoskeletal signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover platelet activation, SNARE-dependent granule secretion and integrin-actin cytoskeletal remodelling, framed as the effector response of platelets triggered by thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signalling.

reading_2.theme: Platelet activation, signalling and degranulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the platelet's internal response machinery, meaning integrin-talin-actin cytoskeletal remodelling, SNARE-mediated granule secretion and degranulation, which carries out activation triggered by the thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signals in the additional set.

shared: granzyme-mediated programmed cell death signaling pathway
protection from natural killer cell mediated cytotoxicity
antigen processing and presentation of endogenous peptide antigen
regulation of natural killer cell degranulation
antigen processing and presentation of exogenous peptide antigen via MHC class Ib

reading_1.theme: NK and cytotoxic T cell killing and its regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe granzyme-mediated killing, NK degranulation and MHC class I/Ib antigen presentation that protects targets, framed as the effector and recognition core of NK/CD8 cytotoxicity and its tolerance controls.

reading_2.theme: NK and cytotoxic T cell killing and its regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are cytotoxic effector control (NK degranulation, granzyme-mediated death, protection from NK killing via MHC class Ib and endogenous peptide presentation), i.e. the recognition-and-killing step that NK and CD8 T cells execute and that tolerance mechanisms restrain.

shared: positive regulation of tumor necrosis factor superfamily cytokine production
positive regulation of toll-like receptor 3 signaling pathway
negative regulation of toll-like receptor signaling pathway
positive regulation of toll-like receptor 4 signaling pathway
positive regulation of cytokine production involved in inflammatory response

reading_1.theme: Toll-like receptor-driven inflammatory cytokine production
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are regulation of TLR3/TLR4 signalling and induction of IL-6, IL-8 and TNF, the inflammatory cytokine output of TLR signalling through TRIF/MyD88, TAK1 and IKK.

reading_2.theme: Toll-like receptor signalling to inflammatory cytokine production
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover TLR3/4-driven production of TNF, IL-6 and IL-8 and its negative control, framed as the output of MyD88/TRIF adaptor, TRAF6/TAK1 and RIP1 signalling, including TRIF-mediated cell death.

reading_1.theme: Amino acid catabolism: aromatic, threonine and glycine pathways
reading_1.core_role: The shared glycine/glyoxylate pathways act as a downstream convergence point where threonine and other amino acid catabolism (alongside phenylalanine/tyrosine breakdown) generate or interconvert glycine.

reading_2.theme: Aromatic and glycine-related amino acid catabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways concern glycine synthesis and glyoxylate metabolism, read here as an end point of amino acid catabolism, with threonine yielding glycine alongside phenylalanine/tyrosine degradation (and phenylketonuria).

reading_1.theme: Osmotic stress response and renal ion transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover osmosensing, hyper- and hypotonic responses and renal sodium/chloride transport, framed as cellular volume and osmotic homeostasis achieved by regulating ion fluxes.

reading_2.theme: Renal salt transport and osmotic regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are renal sodium/chloride transport and cellular osmotic volume responses, implemented by SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters and potassium channels whose defects cause Bartter and Gitelman syndromes.

shared: obsolete negative regulation of proteolysis involved in protein catabolic process
negative regulation of proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process
ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the N-end rule pathway
Cooperation of PDCL (PhLP1) and TRiC/CCT in G-protein beta folding
ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the C-end degron rule pathway

reading_1.theme: Proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-dependent protein degradation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame proteasomal proteolysis and its regulation (degron rules, ERAD control, deubiquitinating enzymes, protein destabilization) as the degradative function of the proteasome whose assembly the additional pathways describe.

reading_2.theme: Protein quality control via proteasomal and autophagic degradation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the proteasome and ubiquitin/degron-dependent degradation machinery (with ERAD control, deubiquitinases and chaperone folding) that forms the proteasomal arm of clearing misfolded or unstable proteins, complementing the aggrephagy and autophagy routes.

shared: Anchoring of the basal body to the plasma membrane
positive regulation of non-motile cilium assembly

reading_1.theme: Centriole, basal body and primary cilium biogenesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover centriole duplication/elongation, basal body docking and cilium assembly/disassembly regulation, framed as the centriole-based foundation for ciliogenesis and intraflagellar ciliary trafficking.

reading_2.theme: Primary cilium assembly, trafficking and disassembly
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover control of ciliogenesis at the basal body and centriole (centriole elongation, centrosome duplication, basal body docking, cilium assembly and disassembly), the structural cycle within which intraflagellar transport and BBSome cargo targeting build and maintain the cilium.

shared: Biosynthesis of protectin and resolvin conjugates in tissue regeneration (PCTR and RCTR)
arachidonate metabolite production involved in inflammatory response
Biosynthesis of electrophilic ω-3 PUFA oxo-derivatives
Biosynthesis of maresin conjugates in tissue regeneration (MCTR)

reading_1.theme: Specialized pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the lipoxygenase-driven oxygenation of arachidonate and omega-3 PUFAs (lipoxins, 5-/15-HETE derivatives, electrophilic oxo-derivatives, maresin/protectin/resolvin conjugates), framed as precursor branches of the mediators that resolve inflammation and promote tissue regeneration.

reading_2.theme: Specialized pro-resolving lipid mediators and eicosanoid metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the biosynthesis of lipoxins, resolvins, protectins, maresins and related PUFA derivatives, framed as lipid mediators of inflammation resolution and tissue regeneration alongside eicosanoid inactivation by omega-oxidation.

shared: negative regulation of microglial cell activation
positive regulation of microglial cell activation

reading_1.theme: Amyloid-beta and glial regulation in neurodegeneration
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are regulation of amyloid-beta formation and clearance, neurofibrillary tangle assembly and microglia/astrocyte activation, framed as the pathological processes of Alzheimer-type neurodegeneration.

reading_2.theme: Glial activation and amyloid pathology in neurodegeneration
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe regulation of microglial and astrocyte activation together with amyloid-beta and tau handling, framed as the neuroinflammatory glial response in Alzheimer-type amyloid pathology.

shared: establishment of protein localization to chromatin

reading_1.theme: Chromatin assembly and histone acetylation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are histone and protein acetylation and nucleosome assembly and remodelling, chromatin organization coupled to DNA replication and repair, with heterochromatin formation in senescence as the wider context.

reading_2.theme: Chromatin assembly and histone acetylation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover nucleosome assembly, histone/protein acetylation and repair-coupled chromatin remodelling, framed as chromatin organization regulating replication, repair and senescence-associated heterochromatin.

shared: positive regulation of type II interferon production
positive regulation of T-helper 1 type immune response

reading_1.theme: Dendritic cell-driven Th1 cytokine immunity
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe IL-12, IFN-gamma, GM-CSF and Th1 cytokine production, framed here as the Th1-polarising output of activated dendritic cells responding to intracellular pathogens such as protozoa.

reading_2.theme: IL-12 and IFN-gamma driven Th1 immune response
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Th1-polarizing cytokine outputs (IL-12, IFN-gamma, GM-CSF), framed as the effector signals of Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma signalling.

shared: positive regulation of high-density lipoprotein particle clearance

reading_1.theme: HDL assembly and reverse cholesterol transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame ABCA1/apoA-I-driven cholesterol efflux and nascent HDL formation as the initiating step of reverse cholesterol transport, upstream of lipoprotein remodeling and LXR-regulated macrophage lipid homeostasis.

reading_2.theme: HDL biogenesis and reverse cholesterol transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe ABCA1/apoA-I-driven cholesterol efflux and HDL particle assembly and clearance, framed here as the mechanism of cellular sterol homeostasis by exporting cholesterol to HDL.

shared: Transport of glycerol from adipocytes to the liver by Aquaporins

reading_1.theme: Aquaglyceroporin glycerol transport and thermogenic fat metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are aquaporin-mediated glycerol and urea transport, framed as adipocyte glycerol release during lipolysis that feeds fatty acid cycling and thermogenesis.

reading_2.theme: Aquaporin water and solute transport in renal water homeostasis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover aquaglyceroporin and urea channel transport of small neutral solutes (glycerol, urea). They sit beside vasopressin-regulated aquaporin water reabsorption in the kidney, where urea transport contributes to urine concentration.

shared: SEMA3A-Plexin repulsion signaling by inhibiting Integrin adhesion

reading_1.theme: Axon guidance by repulsive and attractive cues
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe ephrin and Sema3A repulsion with growth cone collapse and fasciculation, framed as the repulsive core of a broader guidance system including Slit/Robo, netrin, L1 and Rho GTPase cytoskeletal control.

reading_2.theme: Axon guidance by repulsive and attractive cues
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the repulsive guidance arm (semaphorin-3A and ephrin signalling, growth cone collapse, microtubule destabilization, fasciculation) used within axon pathfinding alongside netrin, Slit/Robo and L1 cues acting through Rho GTPases.

shared: negative regulation of macrophage cytokine production
negative regulation of monocyte chemotactic protein-1 production

reading_1.theme: Monocyte/macrophage inflammatory activation and recruitment
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover monocyte activation and proinflammatory cytokine/chemokine output, including negative regulation of MCP-1 and macrophage cytokines. Here they are the tunable signal driving monocyte chemotaxis, extravasation and RAGE/scavenger receptor-triggered recruitment.

reading_2.theme: Restraint of myeloid inflammatory cytokine and chemokine production
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe monocyte/macrophage activation and proinflammatory cytokine and chemokine output, framed as the myeloid inflammatory response that is being negatively regulated.

reading_1.theme: Xenobiotic, alcohol and toxin detoxification
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are phase I/II metabolism of xenobiotics, ethanol, mycotoxins and steroids, framed as detoxification that ends in aldehyde clearance.

reading_2.theme: Xenobiotic and drug metabolism (phase I/II detoxification)
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the core phase I oxidation (cytochromes, alcohol oxidation) and phase II sulfonation that detoxify toxins, mycotoxins, ethanol and steroids. Here this is the generic detoxification machinery that drug ADME, CYP/FMO reactions and conjugations apply.

shared: retrograde vesicle-mediated transport, Golgi to endoplasmic reticulum

reading_1.theme: COPI vesicle traffic and Golgi organization
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover COPI vesicle budding for Golgi-to-ER retrograde and intra-Golgi anterograde transport. Here this trafficking engine maintains Golgi structure, ribbon assembly and disassembly, and constitutive secretion.

reading_2.theme: ER-Golgi vesicle trafficking via COPI and COPII
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are COPI vesicle budding and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic, framed as the return arm of the early secretory pathway complementing COPII-mediated ER export.

reading_1.theme: GABA and glutamate neurotransmitter uptake and metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are GABA synthesis, import and reuptake, framed as inhibitory transmitter cycling alongside excitatory amino acid transporters that supply and clear its precursor glutamate.

reading_2.theme: GABA neurotransmitter metabolism and transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover GABA synthesis and its reuptake into cells, forming the production-and-recycling half of the GABA life cycle completed by its secretion and degradation.

shared: positive regulation of prostaglandin biosynthetic process
negative regulation of prostaglandin biosynthetic process
cellular response to prostaglandin E stimulus

reading_1.theme: Eicosanoid and lipid mediator biosynthesis in inflammation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe arachidonic acid release and the cyclooxygenase/P450 prostaglandin and thromboxane branch with its receptors, one arm of lipid mediator signalling alongside leukotrienes and pro-resolving mediators.

reading_2.theme: Eicosanoid and specialised pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the cyclooxygenase and P450 epoxygenase branches of arachidonic acid metabolism producing prostanoids and their receptors, alongside the lipoxygenase leukotriene, lipoxin and resolvin branches.

shared: Defective SLC5A7 in the neurotransmitter release cycle causes distal hereditary motor neuronopathy 7A (HMN7A)
positive regulation of synaptic transmission, cholinergic
Defective transport by SLC5A7 causes distal hereditary motor neuronopathy 7A (HMN7A)

reading_1.theme: Neurotransmitter synthesis, release and reuptake
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover cholinergic transmission (choline transport, acetylcholine synthesis and release, neuromuscular synapse, SLC5A7 disease), framed as one neurotransmitter system among GABA, glycine and glutamate handling at synapses.

reading_2.theme: Cholinergic neuromuscular synaptic transmission
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the presynaptic cholinergic arm: high-affinity choline uptake by SLC5A7, acetylcholine synthesis and acetylcholine release (with SLC5A7 defects causing motor neuronopathy). Together these supply transmitter to the postsynaptic nicotinic acetylcholine receptors.

shared: positive regulation of cardiac muscle adaptation
positive regulation of cell growth involved in cardiac muscle cell development
negative regulation of cardiac muscle adaptation

reading_1.theme: Muscle growth and adaptive remodeling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover control of cardiomyocyte size, sarcomere organization and hypertrophic adaptation. This is the cardiac case of muscle adaptation, alongside skeletal muscle atrophy, regeneration and fiber-type switching in response to activity.

reading_2.theme: Muscle growth, hypertrophy and adaptation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are cardiomyocyte size control and adaptive hypertrophy, including sarcomere organisation, presented as part of striated muscle remodelling together with skeletal muscle atrophy, regeneration, activity responses and fibre-type switching.

shared: positive regulation of B cell differentiation

[untitled BTM module] This grouping describes lymphocyte activation within organised lymphoid tissue, the process by which antigen-experienced B and T cells are positioned, co-stimulated and driven toward antibody secretion. It underlies germinal centre reactions and the generation of plasma cells, and its components are the surface markers used to identify activated and malignant lymphoid cells.
enriched in naive and memory B cells
positive regulation of B cell proliferation
RUNX1 regulates transcription of genes involved in BCR signaling
positive regulation of B cell receptor signaling pathway
B cell proliferation involved in immune response

reading_1.theme: B cell development, activation and differentiation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways define the B lineage itself, covering B cell identity, BCR signalling, proliferation and differentiation toward plasma cells, framed as lymphocyte development with a thymocyte module adding only peripheral T-lineage context.

reading_2.theme: B cell activation and humoral immune differentiation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe B cell identity, BCR signalling, proliferation and differentiation, framed as the activation base from which germinal centre, plasma cell and memory B responses with T follicular help arise.

shared: Autodegradation of the E3 ubiquitin ligase COP1
positive regulation of intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway in response to DNA damage
positive regulation of intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway by p53 class mediator
Regulation of TP53 Activity through Phosphorylation
positive regulation of DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator
Loss of function of TP53 in cancer due to loss of tetramerization ability

reading_1.theme: p53-mediated DNA damage response
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe p53 activation by phosphorylation and its loss in cancer, promoting intrinsic apoptosis after DNA damage, framed as the pro-apoptotic arm of a p53 program that also enforces cell-cycle arrest and senescence.

reading_2.theme: p53-mediated DNA damage response and cell-cycle checkpoints
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are p53 activation and its control (phosphorylation, COP1, tetramerization loss) driving damage-induced apoptosis, within cell-cycle checkpoint control and ARF-dependent tumour suppression.

shared: Defective SLC4A4 causes renal tubular acidosis, proximal, with ocular abnormalities and mental retardation (pRTA-OA)
Defective SLC4A1 causes hereditary spherocytosis type 4 (HSP4),  distal renal tubular acidosis (dRTA) and dRTA with hemolytic anemia (dRTA-HA)

reading_1.theme: Anion exchange and acid-base transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are SLC4 bicarbonate transport and its defects (renal tubular acidosis, spherocytosis), framed as acid-base and pH regulation alongside SLC26 anion exchangers, sodium/proton exchangers and carbonic anhydrase.

reading_2.theme: Ion transport in acid-base balance and tissue mineralization
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame SLC4 bicarbonate transport and its defects (renal tubular acidosis, spherocytosis) as acid-base ion handling that, alongside phosphate and calcium transporters, supports enamel and tissue mineralization.

reading_1.theme: Phospholipid synthesis and membrane lipid translocation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe flippase/scramblase movement and transfer of phospholipids between leaflets and membranes, framed as the distribution step for phospholipids (PS, PE, PC, PG, cardiolipin) synthesized and remodeled elsewhere.

reading_2.theme: Phospholipid synthesis, remodelling and membrane distribution
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the movement of phospholipids between and across membranes, flipping and scrambling and intermembrane transfer that distribute the newly synthesised and remodelled PS, PE, PC, PG and cardiolipin.

shared: transcription pausing by RNA polymerase II
Formation of RNA Pol II elongation complex
Abortive elongation of HIV-1 transcript in the absence of Tat
Formation of the Early Elongation Complex
RNA Pol II CTD phosphorylation and interaction with CE during HIV infection

reading_1.theme: RNA polymerase II initiation and elongation, including HIV transcription
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the host Pol II promoter-proximal steps, covering pre-transcription events, CTD phosphorylation and capping enzyme recruitment, pausing and early elongation complex formation, which HIV-1 Tat hijacks to overcome abortive elongation of the viral transcript.

reading_2.theme: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation, pausing and elongation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe promoter-proximal Pol II pausing, CTD phosphorylation and early elongation complex formation, framed as the host transcription checkpoint that HIV Tat exploits to drive viral transcription.

shared: Signaling by FGFR3 fusions in cancer
Signaling by plasma membrane FGFR1 fusions

reading_1.theme: Oncogenic FGFR signalling in cancer
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are oncogenic FGFR1-3 fusion signalling, framed as one mode of aberrant FGFR activation in cancer alongside receptor amplification.

reading_2.theme: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase fusions in cancer
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are FGFR1/2/3 fusion signalling, presented as one family of constitutively active RTK fusion drivers alongside PDGFR, LTK and ALK oncogenic kinases.

shared: Loss-of-function mutations in DLD cause MSUD3/DLDD
PDH complex synthesizes acetyl-CoA from PYR

reading_1.theme: Mitochondrial 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and catabolism of amino acids
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways center on lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes (PDH, OGDH, OADH, DLD) and the TCA cycle, framed as the entry hub through which pyruvate, lysine and branched-chain amino acid catabolism, with their inborn errors, feed acyl-CoAs into mitochondrial oxidation.

reading_2.theme: Mitochondrial 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and TCA cycle
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe the lipoylated PDH, OGDH and OADH complexes feeding the TCA cycle and lysine/glycine degradation, framed as the oxidative core connected to Fe-S cluster maturation, succinate dehydrogenase and ATP synthesis.

shared: regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure by endothelin
obsolete regulation of nitric oxide mediated signal transduction
negative regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure
negative regulation of receptor guanylyl cyclase signaling pathway

reading_1.theme: cGMP-mediated regulation of blood pressure and natriuresis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe NO/natriuretic cGMP signalling, vasodilation, endothelin and renal sodium/urine control, framed as integrated cardiovascular-renal regulation of blood pressure.

reading_2.theme: NO/natriuretic peptide cGMP signalling controlling blood pressure
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover guanylyl-cyclase cGMP production and its outputs (vasodilation, natriuresis, diuresis, lower systemic and pulmonary pressure). Here they are the effector arm of eNOS-derived nitric oxide signalling that relaxes vascular smooth muscle.

shared: positive regulation of non-motile cilium assembly
Anchoring of the basal body to the plasma membrane
de novo centriole assembly involved in multi-ciliated epithelial cell differentiation

reading_1.theme: Cilium biogenesis, ciliary trafficking and motility
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the centriole and basal body foundation of cilia, centriole duplication, basal body docking and control of cilium assembly and disassembly, on which intraflagellar trafficking and motile axoneme function are built.

reading_2.theme: Cilium and centriole biogenesis and function
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the centriole/basal body machinery that nucleates and anchors cilia and controls cilium assembly and disassembly, the base for ciliary transport, motile cilia, sperm flagella and brain ventricle development.

shared: regulation of entry of bacterium into host cell
Attachment of bacteria to epithelial cells
obsolete cytolysis by host of symbiont cells
biological process involved in interaction with symbiont

reading_1.theme: Mucosal innate antibacterial defence
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are host antimicrobial effector mechanisms at epithelial surfaces (bacterial agglutination, metal sequestration, killing of Gram-positive bacteria, control of bacterial attachment and entry), framed as defence against invasive bacteria such as Listeria.

reading_2.theme: Antimicrobial innate defence at mucosae
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe mucosal antibacterial effectors (agglutination, metal sequestration, bacterial cytolysis, limiting bacterial attachment and entry), framed as part of neutrophil- and humoral-mediated innate killing of bacteria and fungi.

shared: negative regulation of interleukin-1 alpha production
negative regulation of cytokine production involved in inflammatory response
negative regulation of interleukin-1 beta production

reading_1.theme: Inflammasome and IL-1 inflammatory regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are negative regulation of IL-1 and IL-12 production and of IL-1/Toll signalling, the restraining side of inflammasome-driven IL-1 inflammation.

reading_2.theme: Inflammasome activation and interleukin-1 regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe restraint of IL-1, IL-12 and Toll-driven inflammatory cytokine production, framed as the negative-control side of NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated IL-1 processing.

shared: positive regulation of regulatory T cell differentiation
negative regulation of CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell proliferation
negative regulation of T-helper 17 cell lineage commitment
negative regulation of type II interferon production
negative regulation of CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell activation
negative regulation of T cell cytokine production
regulation of CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell differentiation
positive regulation of CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell proliferation
negative regulation of activated T cell proliferation

reading_1.theme: Regulatory T cell-mediated suppression of T cell activation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe induction of Tregs and dampening of CD4/CD8 proliferation, IFN-gamma and Th17 commitment, framed as immunosuppression delivered through costimulatory and antigen-presenting cell contact.

reading_2.theme: T cell tolerance and regulatory T cell control
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame the regulatory brakes on CD4 and CD8 T cell proliferation, effector cytokines and Th17 commitment, together with Treg differentiation, as the mechanisms of peripheral tolerance.

shared: positive regulation of apoptotic process involved in development
positive regulation of cellular response to hypoxia
negative regulation of cellular response to oxidative stress

reading_1.theme: Hypoxia and oxidative stress-induced apoptosis regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe how cells tune responses to hypoxia and oxidative stress and developmental apoptosis, framed as inputs to the mitochondrial intrinsic apoptotic pathway triggered by peroxide or oxygen-glucose deprivation.

reading_2.theme: Mitochondrial respiration control under hypoxic and oxidative stress
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are cellular responses to hypoxia, oxidative stress and developmental apoptosis, framed as the stress and cell-fate outcomes of tuning mitochondrial respiration and ROS production.

reading_1.theme: Amino acid and organic acid catabolism via glycine
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe threonine and general L-amino acid breakdown converging on glycine and glyoxylate, here extended to alanine metabolism as a related transamination route.

reading_2.theme: Amino acid catabolism and organic acid metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover threonine, glycine and glyoxylate metabolism among general amino/organic acid pathways, framed as part of broad amino acid catabolism including aromatic, proline and histidine breakdown and glycine conjugation.

shared: positive regulation of glomerular mesangial cell proliferation

reading_1.theme: Metanephric nephron and glomerulus development
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are glomerulus formation (mesangial, endothelial and epithelial development and vascularisation), the filtering unit within nephron and tubule segment development.

reading_2.theme: Kidney nephron development: glomerulus and tubule segments
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are glomerular development (mesangial, endothelial, epithelial and vascular components), the filtering-corpuscle part of nephron morphogenesis alongside development of tubule segments and control of renal progenitor proliferation.

shared: SARS-CoV-2 targets host intracellular signalling and regulatory pathways
SARS-CoV-2 targets PDZ proteins in cell-cell junction
SARS-CoV-1 targets host intracellular signalling and regulatory pathways
SARS-CoV-1 targets PDZ proteins in cell-cell junction

reading_1.theme: Viral attachment, entry and host manipulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are coronavirus manipulation of host signalling and junctional PDZ proteins, the post-entry host-interaction phase alongside viral attachment, entry and assembly.

reading_2.theme: Viral protein maturation and host manipulation during infection
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe SARS-CoV-1/2 targeting of host PDZ junction proteins and intracellular signalling, framed as viral manipulation of the host cell within a broader programme of viral protein processing and assembly.

reading_1.theme: Sperm flagellar motility and spermatogenesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover sperm motility, mitochondrial sheath assembly, ciliary beating and the Sertoli cell barrier. These form the structural and energetic basis of the flagellum, supported by kinesins and microtubule severing and depolymerization.

reading_2.theme: Motile cilia and sperm flagellum function
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are sperm-specific flagellar assembly and motility (mitochondrial sheath, motility regulation, Sertoli barrier), framed as the sperm instance of motile axoneme biology that also drives mucociliary clearance and CSF flow.

shared: positive regulation of immature T cell proliferation in thymus
positive regulation of T cell differentiation in thymus
negative regulation of immature T cell proliferation in thymus
negative regulation of thymocyte apoptotic process

reading_1.theme: Control of thymocyte and hematopoietic cell numbers
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover thymic regulation of immature T cell proliferation, survival and differentiation. Here this is one instance of tissue cell-number homeostasis, paralleled by proliferation and apoptosis control in bone marrow.

reading_2.theme: Thymocyte development, selection and survival
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame the proliferation, survival and differentiation of thymocytes as the developmental substrate on which positive and negative selection and tolerance act.

shared: establishment of mitotic sister chromatid cohesion

reading_1.theme: Mitotic chromosome organisation by cohesin and condensin
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe cohesin loading, cohesion establishment and chromatin looping, framed as the cohesion side of chromosome structuring that is complemented by condensin-driven chromosome condensation.

reading_2.theme: Sister chromatid cohesion establishment and resolution
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe cohesin loading and cohesion establishment (with chromatin looping), framed as the first stage of a cohesion cycle that is maintained at centromeres and then resolved at chromatid separation.

Negative feedback regulation of MAPK pathway
Inhibition of TSC complex formation by AKT (PKB)
negative regulation of Ras protein signal transduction
RAS signaling downstream of NF1 loss-of-function variants
Gain-of-function MRAS complexes activate RAF signaling

reading_1.theme: FGFR-RAS-MAPK signalling and its oncogenic dysregulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the core RAS-ERK module with its feedback inhibition and RAS/MAP2K mutant signalling, framed as the common downstream hub fed by FGFR (and IGF1R) receptor activation and RAF mutants.

reading_2.theme: RAS-MAPK signalling downstream of FGF receptors
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the RAS-ERK relay and its brakes (RAS GAPs and NF1, SOS/SHC adaptors, ERK inactivation, phosphatases, negative feedback, oncogenic RAS/MAP2K mutants), the core cascade through which FGFR and RAF signals reach ERK.

shared: regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure by vasopressin

Defective AVP does not bind AVPR1A,B and causes neurohypophyseal diabetes insipidus (NDI)
Vasopressin regulates renal water homeostasis via Aquaporins

reading_1.theme: Vasopressin-aquaporin control of renal water homeostasis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe vasopressin receptor signalling and aquaporin-mediated renal water reabsorption, framed as systemic water balance, with aquaporins extended to glycerol and urea transport.

reading_2.theme: Renal water and salt homeostasis and osmoregulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the vasopressin-aquaporin water-reabsorption arm of body fluid homeostasis, alongside renal sodium, potassium and chloride transport and cellular osmotic responses.

shared: negative regulation of apoptotic process involved in development
mesenchymal stem cell maintenance involved in nephron morphogenesis
obsolete cell differentiation involved in metanephros development
regulation of mesenchymal to epithelial transition involved in metanephros morphogenesis
negative regulation of mesenchymal cell apoptotic process

reading_1.theme: Kidney development: ureteric bud branching and nephron induction
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame the metanephric mesenchyme side of kidney induction, its maintenance, survival and mesenchymal-to-epithelial conversion into nephron tubules, in response to the ureteric bud and nephric duct formation in the additional set.

reading_2.theme: Metanephric mesenchyme differentiation and kidney size control
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover nephron progenitor survival, maintenance and mesenchymal-to-epithelial conversion into tubules, framed as the cellular mechanism by which nephron number and kidney size are set and restrained.

reading_1.theme: Glutamate, aspartate and nitrogen metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate, glutamine and aspartate interconversions for nitrogen utilization, framed as the amino acid nitrogen core linked to ammonium homeostasis, the malate-aspartate shuttle and creatine metabolism.

reading_2.theme: Amino acid and nitrogen metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover glutamate, glutamine and aspartate metabolism, framed as the nitrogen-handling transamination hub linking the broader catabolism of amino acids (tyrosine, phenylalanine, proline) to the TCA cycle and gluconeogenesis.

shared: regulation of DNA-templated DNA replication initiation

reading_1.theme: Replication stress and DNA damage response at stalled forks
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame replication-stress lesions (camptothecin/hydroxyurea damage, R-loops, DNA-protein crosslinks, origin firing control) as the damage that triggers PARP-mediated ADP-ribosylation, checkpoint signalling and break-site chromatin repair.

reading_2.theme: Replication stress response and DNA repair regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways concern responses to replication-blocking lesions (hydroxyurea, camptothecin-trapped topoisomerase, DNA-protein crosslinks, R-loops) and origin firing control, set within PARP-mediated ADP-ribosylation, checkpoint signalling and double-strand break repair choice.

reading_1.theme: Cellular energy buffering and glycolytic ATP supply
reading_1.core_role: The shared creatine/phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ATP/ADP exchange pathways form the phosphocreatine shuttle that buffers and distributes ATP, here framed alongside glycolytic and fermentative ATP production.

reading_2.theme: Cellular energy supply: glycolysis and phosphocreatine buffering
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are mitochondrial ATP/ADP exchange and the creatine/phosphocreatine shuttle, framed as the high-energy phosphate buffer linking mitochondrial ATP to cytosolic demand alongside glycolytic ATP production.
